directories.name: Atrium — Australian Tech Communities
directories.description: 100+ communities, startup hubs, accelerators, co-working spaces, and founder networks. VC/growth-oriented rather than commons.

directories.name: Australian Design Centre — Repair Map
directories.description: Sydney-focused repair community map. Shows the vibrant repair ecosystem around Sydney — cafés, mending groups, reuse centres.

directories.name: Australian Makerspace Directory
directories.description: Interactive map of makerspaces, hackerspaces, and community workshops. Filter by equipment and features. The most comprehensive maker-only directory.

directories.name: Civic Tech Field Guide — Australia
directories.description: Part of a global inventory of 8,000+ civic tech projects. Lists tools and organisations (OpenAustralia, Planning Alerts, NationalMap) rather than meetup communities.

directories.name: Core Electronics — Makerspaces
directories.description: Community-driven makerspace finder from the Newcastle hardware retailer. Map-based, equipment-focused. Hosts the TTN Newcastle meetup.

directories.name: Linux Australia — LUGs
directories.description: Peak body for open-source in Australasia. Lists Linux User Groups by state plus a hackerspaces page linking to the Hackerspaces Wiki and mailing list.

directories.name: MeshMap.me — The Mesh Directory
directories.description: Global directory of LoRa mesh organisations, groups, and clubs — Meshtastic, MeshCore, Reticulum, and LoRa radio mesh technology.

directories.name: OpenAustralia Foundation
directories.description: Builds free, open-source civic tech — Planning Alerts (198k+ development applications), They Vote For You, Right to Know (FOI requests). Relies on donations.

directories.name: Repair Cafés & Fix-It — Australia Map
directories.description: Community-maintained Google Map of 100+ repair events nationally. Drop-in sessions, tool libraries, electronics reuse hubs.

directories.name: Tech Groups
directories.description: Aggregator for tech meetups, conferences, and events across Australian cities. Broad and uncurated — every React meetup and AWS user group alongside everything else.

directories.name: Techboard — Startup + Tech Mapping
directories.description: National startup and tech mapping project. Originally WA-focused, now expanded nationally. VC/growth lens — complements but doesn't overlap commons tech.

directories.name: WIA — Club Directory
directories.description: Wireless Institute of Australia (est. 1910) — the world's oldest national amateur radio society. Lists every affiliated club by state. Comprehensive for radio, nothing else.

directories.name: wireless.org.au — Community Networks
directories.description: Australian community wireless networks — Meshtastic, LoRaWAN, legacy mesh. Groups by state, Discord links. Also covers Meshtastic AU specifically.
